# coval_scheduled_runs (Data Source)

Lists Coval scheduled runs visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_scheduled_runs" "paused" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Optional enabled-state filter.
- `run_template_id` (String) Optional run-template filter.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `scheduled_runs` (Attributes List) All matching scheduled runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_runs))
